card.name: Town and locality words in place names
card.fires_on: The word town or towns at the end of a compound like hometown, farm town or hill towns, and similar words for a local community such as locality or commune. It also fires on small linking words right after a town.

modes.label: Compound ending in town
modes.description: The word town or towns completes a compound describing a kind of small community.
